## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue if any.

## Validation

List the commands and results. For a check that did not run, state why.

## Compatibility

State any change to public APIs, CLI behavior, stored bytes, formats, source
identity, cursors or control events. Write "None" when these are unchanged.

- [ ] This change stays within the repository scope.
- [ ] Relevant tests or documentation checks are included.
- [ ] No credentials, private records or full benchmark result sets are included.
